meta.summary: A left outer join: the unmatched row is kept with NULLs, and one row matches twice.

mkp-data:join@1.name: join
mkp-data:join@1.about: Two relations and their join on a key: step through the left rows and see each one's matches join the result.

inputs.name: left
inputs.about: the left relation

inputs.name: right
inputs.about: the right relation

inputs.name: on
inputs.about: the key column of the left relation

inputs.name: righton
inputs.about: the key column of the right relation, when its name differs

inputs.name: kind
inputs.about: inner keeps matched rows only; leftouter keeps every left row

inputs.name: title
inputs.about: the header's title; by default the query

values.name: matches
values.body: filter(range(0, len(right.rows) - 1), j => cell(right.cols, right.rows[j], rkey) == lkey(i))

values.name: rkeep
comment: the right columns the result keeps (not the key again), named apart from the left's

value.expr: left.cols + map(rkeep, c => if(indexof(left.cols, right.cols[c]) >= 0, rname + "." + right.cols[c], right.cols[c]))

values.name: pairs

value.expr: flatten(map(range(0, len(left.rows) - 1), i => if(len(matches(i)) == 0 and kind == leftouter, [{i: i, j: -1}], map(matches(i), j => {i: i, j: j}))))

comment: every joined pair in order of the left rows; an unmatched left row pairs with -1 in a left outer join

value.expr: "SELECT * FROM " + lname + if(kind == leftouter, " LEFT JOIN ", " JOIN ") + rname + " ON " + lname + "." + on + " = " + rname + "." + rkey

values.name: linetone
comment: the lines so far: the current row's strong, the ones before it faded

value.expr: map(filter(pairs, p => p.j >= 0 and p.i <= pos), p => {from: p.i, to: p.j, tone: linetone(), line: linelook(), label: "", bold: p.i == pos, dim: p.i < pos})

values.name: firstfor
values.body: at(filter(range(0, len(left.rows) - 1), i => lkey(i) == cell(right.cols, right.rows[j], rkey)), 0, pos)
comment: a right row picked goes to the first left row it matches

status.expr: "**" + on + " = " + lkey(pos) + "** " + if(len(hits) == 0, "matches no row of " + rname + if(kind == leftouter, ", so the row is kept with NULLs.", ", so it adds nothing."), "matches " + len(hits) + " row" + if(len(hits) == 1, "", "s") + " of " + rname + ".")

a.v: , so the row is kept with NULLs.

comment: as wide as the frame, or as the tables when they need more: then the stage scrolls
a pane in a row of its own: panes share a row's width

tone.expr: if(pairs[k].j < 0 and c >= len(left.cols), muted, ink)

md.expr:
"`" + sql + "`

**" + lname + "**

" + mdtable(left.cols, left.rows) + "
**" + rname + "**

" + mdtable(right.cols, right.rows) + "
**result** (" + len(pairs) + " rows)

" + mdtable(outcols, map(pairs, p => row(p)))

local:mkp-data:join@1:matches#0<int>.name: matches
local:mkp-data:join@1:matches#0<int>.src: filter(range(0, len(right.rows) - 1), j => cell(right.cols, right.rows[j], rkey) == lkey(i))

local:mkp-data:join@1:firstfor#0.name: firstfor
local:mkp-data:join@1:firstfor#0.src: at(filter(range(0, len(left.rows) - 1), i => lkey(i) == cell(right.cols, right.rows[j], rkey)), 0, pos)

core:press@1.name: press
core:press@1.about: Anything clickable and focusable: a button, a tab, an option among others, an on/off toggle or switch, an answer row with a tick (check) or a dot (radio), or its content itself, such as a card (plain).

inputs.name: label
inputs.about: accessible name when the content has no text

inputs.name: emphasis
inputs.about: how much it stands out: low for one of a row of quiet buttons, high for the one to press

core:frame@1.name: frame
core:frame@1.about: A widget's shell: what kind of thing it is and its title above a stage, and a bar of controls along the bottom. Nothing the reader does changes its size: what doesn't fit goes in its drawers or full screen.

inputs.name: kind
inputs.about: what kind of thing it is, said small before the title

inputs.name: height
inputs.about: the stage's height at rest (the reader can drag it); none: as tall as its content

inputs.name: status
inputs.about: one line in the bar: what is happening now

inputs.name: statuslines
inputs.about: how many lines the status keeps room for (1 to 3): a verdict with its reason

inputs.name: tone
inputs.about: tints the bar: how an answer went (ok, bad) or a note (info)

inputs.name: actions
inputs.about: right of the title: the widget's own switches

inputs.name: bar
inputs.about: the bar: what is placed here, after the widget's own controls

inputs.name: about
inputs.about: a drawer: assumptions, and how to read it

inputs.name: details
inputs.about: a drawer: everything at once, such as the full table
